steps: During the awards ceremony, the Imperial Guard surrounds the venue. The whole convention was a trap set by their captain, Greyhorn. With everyone cornered, your group arrives to turn the tide.
W-Whoa! Why's Ticka-Boom firing over there?!
Hey, hey, I can hear you from up here, y'know?! Don't underestimate my Boomy. That little guy never makes mistakes!
Yaaahhh!! My Sparrow Scout Unit! How did they spot it?! It's supposed to be a stealth recon drone?!
See? Told you so just now♪
Heh, your little sparrow's got some guts, though. Took one of my balloon bombs and still managed to reboot.
Seriously, why are you firepower freaks messing with the logistics division's arena?!
Sorryyy~ Ticka-Boom's detection range is just way too wide. Looks like it locked onto all your little automaton units as enemies too.
Besides, the logistics division gets scored on safety standards too, right? Thought we'd help you show off a little, hahaha!
The direct combat round is the final round, okay?! You trigger-happy idiots can't just wreck the event because you feel like it!
Oho? So now you're blaming other people because your builds suck?
Ohhh~ If you're gonna talk that big, then let's see what your firepower can really do. Forget the brackets—bring it on!
Whoa... It turned into a full-on battle royale...
Gray, aren't you gonna stop them?
There's no need. If anything, the automaton that survives a fight of this scale is exactly what we're looking for.
Feels like we're about to get dragged into this too. Should we move farther back?
Relax. The audience seats aren't getting hit at all, right?==W== Wah!==W== Cough cough... Hahaha... Worst case, a little smoke drifts over here.
That's true... Neo-tech craftsmanship really is incredible...
Right?! Some of the gear those genius artisans make can practically match Artifacts, and way cheaper too.
Grace Imperium keeps banning this and restricting that because they're terrified the Soul Shop and Artifact shops will lose business.
... Looks like this is about to end.
Anyone still got an automaton standing? My Ticka-Boom's right here~ Don't be shy, come at me all together ♪
Dammit... My babies got blown to pieces... This is why I hate explosive-type automata...
Leona, just you wait! Give me a couple of days to upgrade my tracking bombs, and your Ticka-Boom won't be bouncing anymore!
Hmph, do your best then ♪==W== Oh, right. Since we're obviously gonna fight again sometime, wanna exchange contacts while we're at it?
Hey, announcer! The winner's obvious already, right?! Hurry up and call it!
Indeed. Since nobody seems to object...==W== I hereby declare the champion of this convention to be—
Miss Leona and her automaton, Ticka-Boom!
Next, we'll begin venue safety inspections and cleanup operations, so please wait a moment. After that, we'll proceed directly to the award ceremony.
Oh dang, there's an award ceremony too?! Congrats, Leona!
Hmph hmph! Told ya this was gonna be easy.
I was hoping that I'd finally get to crush that Sparkla brat who keeps blocking me...==W== But she didn't even show up, so winning doesn't feel nearly as satisfying.
I can increase the commission fee!==W== As long as Sparkla makes it to the convention, first place is basically guaranteed.
How about this then...==W== We split the winnings fifty-fifty!!==W== Even half would still be an absolutely massive fortune!
Bloc just lost her entire life savings! And obviously our reward's gone too!!
The venue cleanup has now concluded.
After the artisans' spectacular competition, we now arrive at the grand finale of today's event—
Members of the Neo Grace Organization, you are under arrest.
Wait... When did this many Imperial Guards get here?!
Weren't those people sitting next to us earlier?!==W== Don't tell me...
I am Greyhorn, Captain of the Imperial Guard.
My duty is to track down and apprehend Neo Grace Organization members hiding across the land.
Don't tell me...! This whole convention was a trap?!
Correct. Rather than chasing rats across the world, it's much more efficient to lure them out and capture them all at once.
NGO artisans are obsessed with invention. Exploit that obsession, and getting you idiots to walk into a trap is easy.
In fact, all we had to do was disguise it as a tech tournament and offer Neo Coins as the grand prize. And just like that, you all came crawling straight into the net.
That's so underhanded! You sneaky bastard!
You criminals aren't exactly in a position to lecture me.

Trekkers present at the venue, do not interfere with Imperial Guard operations. Any obstruction will be treated as aiding the Neo Grace Organization. Additionally, after the arrest operation concludes, all attendees will be required to attend an Artifact safety seminar and examination.
Really? That's all they're doing...? The Imperial Guard actually let us off easy?
So she really is ...==W== the Imperial Guard's infamous "Neo Hound."
Ah! I remember now! She's one of the Imperial Guard members we met before!
Her whole aura feels completely different now.
When she was hanging around with us these past few days, she felt like an entirely different person. No wonder we never noticed who she really was.
For now, let's stay out of it and watch what happens.
If Boss were here, Boss probably wouldn't want everyone dragged into a conflict between the Imperial Guard and the Neo Grace Organization either.
Quit looking down on us! You think we'll just surrender?! Every Dorra on those bounty posters was earned by risking our lives! Everyone standing here is a battle-hardened veteran!
Exactly exactly! A lousy Imperial Guard squad doesn't stand a chance against our automata anyway...==W== Huh?
So you finally noticed? Most of those automata lost functionality during that giant free-for-all earlier.==W== And your Ticka-Boom took serious damage too.
That's what I was saying earlier... I hate explosive automata...
You have nowhere left to run. Surrender peacefully.
Boss! Where are you right now?!
Iris, we're on our...==W== Ah, actually, looks like we're already here.
Sorry to keep everyone waiting~♪ So who won earlier? Wanna put the championship title and prize on the line and duel my Rabbit Pie?
Sparkla! Read the room already?! How is this the time for that?!
Well then. Looks like the last rat finally arrived.
We've met before, haven't we...?==W== Your name was ... Greyhorn, right?
Greetings, CEO of Boss Accord. I strongly advise against interfering with Imperial Guard operations.
If even one Trekker affiliated with Boss Accord makes a move, every person here will be detained as accomplices of the Neo Grace Organization.
She's trying to ... use everyone else to hold me back.
Oh my, fancy running into the Imperial Guard's famous "hound" here.
Wait, Leona didn't show up?==W== Couldn't even handle a tiny mess like this...?==W== Ah, sorry sorry, there you are. Still, dealing with this alone would be rough even for you, huh?
Hey! Don't look down on me! If my Ticka-Boom hadn't burned through so much power during the competition, wiping out this whole Imperial Guard squad would've been easy!
So basically, you can't do anything alone?
Y-You—==W==stop twisting my words like that!!!
Does Sparkla have a terrible relationship with that person?
Hehe, not really...==W== Though those two absolutely start bickering the second they meet. It's basically their own version of saying hello.
They genuinely respect each other's craftsmanship deep down.
What nonsense are you talking about?! She sucks!
Exactly. Seriously, Bloc, what were you thinking? With Leona's skill level, there's no way she could build anything like my Rabbit Pie.
==PLAYER_NAME==, things were way too hectic this morning for me to show you my newest invention properly, so why not see it in live combat instead—
I'll show you what Rabbit Pie looks like when it gets serious ♪
:] Target locked. Enemy formations are densely packed ahead. Estimated requirement: five Neo Bunny Bombs.
Mmm... Not cute enough. And definitely not dramatic enough. Let's just go with "Bunny Full-Area Suppression."
:p Understood. Switching to "Bunny Full-Area Suppression" mode.
==PLAYER_NAME==, get behind me. This is the best seat in the house.
Then I'll gladly accept the invitation.
H-Hey hey hey! Don't forget about me over here?!
Sparkla's new bombs?! Lemme see those beauties in action too!
R-Report...==W== Most of our squad has lost combat power, but ... there are no fatalities.
So even defensive magic can barely handle that much...==W== Protecting this many people at once really is too much strain...
As expected of Sparkla! The Imperial Guard got completely wiped out~
Everyone, hurry! Run while you can!
Hmph, trying to flee? I refuse to let any of you escape.
You tanked Rabbit Pie's maximum-output cannon and you're still standing? You're tougher than you look.
In that case...==W== Guess it's finally time to unveil the other little "surprise" I installed into Super Action Pie.
Of course there is ♪ Besides the super high-speed mode, I added a whole bunch of enhancement functions too.
